categories.main_business_segments: INTCO Recycling Resources Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the recycling and reuse of renewable plastic resources. Its main business segments include plastic recycling equipment, recycled plastic particles (r-PS, r-PET, r-PE), finished frames, decorative building materials, PET products, and environmental protection equipment. The company integrates the entire plastic recycling industry chain from collection, regeneration to utilization, focusing on high-value applications in home decoration and consumer goods.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies such as foam densification and compression equipment for PS foam recycling, molecular chain repair and plastic modification for recycled PS particles, multi-layer co-extrusion and micro-foaming for decorative plastic products, and solid-phase polycondensation for food-grade recycled PET. It also develops intelligent manufacturing systems integrating 5S management, digitalization, and automation, including proprietary equipment like intelligent EPP granulators and plastic film cleaning lines.
categories.primary_customers_markets: INTCO serves large international retail chains, home decoration and furniture markets, and industrial sectors requiring recycled plastic materials. Its products are sold globally to over 120 countries, with significant customers in Europe and Southeast Asia. The company maintains long-term partnerships with major overseas retailers and targets mid-to-high-end consumer markets with environmentally friendly plastic products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with production bases in China (Shandong, Shanghai, Anhui, Jiangsu), Malaysia, and Vietnam. It has established a global recycling network sourcing from over 100 countries and markets its products worldwide, including strong presence in Europe, Southeast Asia, and North America. Overseas manufacturing facilities in Malaysia and Vietnam enhance supply chain diversification and local market responsiveness.
categories.supply_chain_position: INTCO operates a vertically integrated supply chain covering upstream plastic waste collection and compression, midstream recycling and granulation of plastic particles, and downstream manufacturing of finished plastic consumer and building products. It also supplies recycling equipment, positioning itself as a full-chain player from raw material sourcing to end-product sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in recycling technologies, product design, and intelligent manufacturing. R&D focuses on improving recycling efficiency, developing food-grade recycled materials, multi-layer co-extrusion techniques, and new product categories like PE/PP recycling and wood-plastic composites. It invests heavily in automation, digitalization, and sustainability, aiming to expand into multi-material recycling and high-value applications while maintaining global competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of recycled plastic particles, finished consumer and building products, and recycling equipment. The company operates on a B2B sales model with both domestic and international customers, leveraging long-term contracts and diversified product offerings. It also benefits from government subsidies and financial income from investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: INTCO is a leading player in China's recycled plastic industry with a unique full-industry chain business model. It holds a competitive advantage through advanced technology, global supply chain integration, and diversified product portfolio. The company competes with other large-scale recycling enterprises but distinguishes itself by combining recycling with consumer product manufacturing and international market penetration.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, INTCO achieved revenue of approximately RMB 2.92 billion, a 19.09% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 307 million, up 57.07%. Total assets exceeded RMB 5.5 billion, with a compound annual growth rate of 14.54% over five years. The company maintains healthy profitability with a return on equity of 12.85% and continues to invest significantly in R&D and overseas expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: INTCO emphasizes sustainable, high-quality recycled plastic products with strong environmental attributes, including carbon footprint tracking and compliance with international standards (FDA, EFSA, GRS). Its products offer cost-effective alternatives to virgin plastics and traditional materials like wood, with enhanced durability and design flexibility. The company’s integrated global recycling network, advanced technology, and customer-centric solutions provide differentiated value in the circular economy.
